sources.title: Zuse Native README
sources.locator: Install; Projects; Paired access; Use another machine; Native browser panel; License
sources.finding: Rust desktop and browser control plane for coding agents (GPUI native, GPUI Web in WebAssembly); downloads for macOS, Windows x64 (unsigned) and Linux x64/arm64; zuse serve --lan/--account; paired access; import from Electron; AGPL-3.0-only; under active implementation.

sources.title: Zuse changelog
sources.finding: v0.26.1 adds Stable/Preview update tracks, first-run setup, standalone zuse command and PR follow-up on failing checks; Slack cloud tasks are Unreleased and opt-in.

sources.title: Implementation and acceptance status
sources.finding: Per-capability status values source, compiled, pending or verified; provider protocols, harness, plugins, archive, Slack and cloud are mostly source/compiled with live acceptance pending.

sources.title: Native harness capabilities
sources.finding: Zuse native Rust harness: bounded parallel reads, nested agents depth 2, durable messages between agents, shared request budget; external coding CLIs do not run on this kernel.

sources.title: Chat permissions
sources.finding: Ask for approval, Approve for me and Full access per adapter; approvals require explicit Yes; saved approval rules on the host; plan mode separate; provider sandboxes are not a uniform OS sandbox.

sources.title: Custom ACP agents
sources.finding: Custom ACP agents added in Settings with executable and arguments; no shell expansion; Zuse does not install them.

sources.title: Model connections
sources.finding: Model accounts for the Zuse harness: ChatGPT OAuth (PKCE) and SuperGrok device authorization, AES-256-GCM local store, hosted storage option; CLI logins remain independent.

sources.title: Hosted plugins and agent workspaces
sources.finding: Hosted plugin API with Personal and organization workspaces; local stdio MCP servers run lazily with a cleared environment.

sources.title: Persistent Zots and application control
sources.locator: Authority and storage; Delivery and supervision
sources.finding: Zots are persistent coordinators with purpose, instructions, decisions, digest and reports that delegate to worker conversations with concurrency limits, durable events and a Rust supervisor.

sources.title: Paired remote access
sources.finding: Noise NNpsk0 encrypted pairing with 10-minute invitations, up to 32 persistent devices, revocable grants, full control of the profile.

sources.title: Account-managed access
sources.finding: Account-linked host access with environment listing, device revocation and a managed host link; remaining acceptance pending.

sources.title: Pull requests
sources.locator: PR board; PR watch and automatic follow-up
sources.finding: Native PR board and browser PR tab with diff, comments, reviewers, create PR, draft/ready/close; PR watch with bounded automatic CI/review follow-up.

sources.title: Local Git controls
sources.finding: Shared Git panel with stage, commit, fetch, push, pull, branches and Open PR; mutations are never auto-retried.

sources.title: Thread archive storage
sources.finding: Archiving checkpoints a managed worktree to a private ref, removes the checkout and restores it before reactivation.

sources.title: Slack app
sources.finding: Slack mention/DM to cloud tasks via signed ingress, encrypted jobs and attribution; source status, opt-in.

sources.title: PostHog product analytics
sources.finding: Product analytics on by default for new engine installs with a Share usage analytics setting and ZUSE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=0 override; no delivery without a configured public ingest token; Do Not Track respected in browser.

sources.title: Analytics crate
sources.finding: Delivery needs a PostHog key; ZUSE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=0 disables regardless of saved preference; consent is stored in analytics.json.

sources.title: Cloud implementation
sources.locator: Milestone ledger; billing usage and cap administration
sources.finding: Hosted cloud rewrite with runtime enrollment, mailbox and billing/cap administration; live provider execution, full archive lifecycle and cutover remain in progress.

sources.finding: Repository LICENSE is AGPL-3.0; README states AGPL-3.0-only.
